events.title: The Buckle-Heart Ward
events.description: A huge patched shield props open a heavy rivet gate as the Warden inspects frayed brass seams.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to sew a lasting shield seam (+3 max HP)
Trade 2 max HP of rivets for 24 gold
Leave the rivet gate untouched

events.title: The Crimson Quilt Surgeon
events.description: A red needle and trailing thread stitch warm quilt bandages beneath a crimson canopy.

choices.text: Pay 12 gold to dress one hero's wounds (+8 HP)
Donate 4 HP of red thread for a purse of 18 gold
Leave the surgeon's quilt

events.title: The Copper-Needle Greenhouse
events.description: Crooked goggles and barbed gears glint among copper-wire ferns and needle-thorn blossoms.

choices.text: Spend 10 gold on soothing gear balm (+6 HP)
Endure 6 HP loss to salvage 3 scraps of barbed gears
Leave the copper greenhouse

events.title: The Thimble-Moon Vigil
events.description: A glowing lantern with a soft moth halo hangs beneath a pale stitched thimble moon.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold to strengthen seams in moonlight (+2 max HP)
Lose 4 HP tending the moth candles; earn 20 gold
Leave the sanctuary undisturbed

events.title: The Velvet Straw Mender
events.description: A tattered cape and needle rapier rest on a bed of warm velvet and straw padding.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps on velvet straw stuffing (+10 HP)
Give up 5 HP worth of cape padding for 22 gold
Tuck the cape in and depart

events.title: The Strawheart Alarm
events.description: The Scarecrow hooks a quilted straw heart above a moonlit crow roost with a long forked pitchfork; black ribbon feathers tremble when it rings.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps patching the straw heart (+8 HP)
Offer 5 HP of stuffing for 2 rescued scraps
Leave the crow roost to its midnight watch

events.title: The Starladder Bolas
events.description: The Ranger's giant braided wool bolas snag a moonlit ladder of crossed knitting needles, its silver rungs hanging between two stitched willow trees.

choices.text: Spend 14 gold for a stronger wool seam (+2 max HP)
Unpick 1 max HP of wool to salvage 2 scraps
Leave the silver ladder hanging

events.title: The Rivet Choir
events.description: The Golem's enormous chest buttons hum beside a choir of bronze rivets sewn into a midnight velvet bell, each bass note shaking its stitches.

choices.text: Pay 17 gold to polish a worn chest seam (+9 HP)
Give up 3 max HP of old brass for 27 gold
Let the bronze choir fall silent

events.title: The Blunderbuss Fuse Well
events.description: A huge blunderbuss rests against the Tinker's overstuffed scrap backpack as copper gear teeth catch sparks above an ink-dark wishing well.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap reinforcing the blunderbuss lining (+2 max HP)
Endure 4 HP of hot fuse sparks to earn 21 gold
Cap the fuse and walk past the well
